added.summary: RenderSettings.maxVfx and maxVfxParticles cap the composed effects (og.Vfx) drawn at once and the particle slots among their emitters: 64 and 65536 by default, 32 and 32768 on the low preset, 128 and 131072 on high. Past either, the oldest one-shot effects are left out first, then the oldest looping ones; the probe's dump_render reports `vfx: { drawn, dropped }`. Drawing only: the effects' events, shakes and sounds still come, and their entities stay. Scenes within the limits draw as before.
